title: AgentSquare: Automatic LLM Agent Search in Modular Design Space
authors: Yu Shang; Yu Li; Keyu Zhao; Likai Ma; Jiahe Liu; Fengli Xu; Yong Li
affiliations: Department of Electronic Engineering, Tsinghua University (Yu Shang, Keyu Zhao, Likai Ma, Jiahe Liu, Fengli Xu, Yong Li);

problem_statement.en: LLM agent designs are hand-crafted and task-specific, which limits their adaptability to novel tasks and leaves the combinatorial space of agent architectures unexplored automatically. The paper introduces "Modularized LLM Agent Search" (MoLAS): given a standardized modular design space, automatically search for a high-performing agent architecture for a target task.
problem_statement.zh: LLM agent 的設計往往仰賴人工手工打造且針對特定任務,此舉限制了其對新任務的適應能力,並使 agent 架構龐大的組合空間無法被自動探索。本文提出「Modularized LLM Agent Search」(MoLAS):在給定一個標準化的模組化設計空間下,自動為目標任務搜尋出一個高效能的 agent 架構。

key_innovation.en: A modular agent design space of four standardized modules with a uniform IO interface (Planning, Reasoning, Tool-Use, Memory), searched offline by two LLM-driven operators — module recombination (an LLM proposer swaps in existing modules) and module evolution (an LLM evolutionary meta-prompt writes brand-new module code) — and accelerated by an in-context LLM surrogate "performance predictor" that scores/ranks recombined candidates to prune (skip) unpromising designs before costly real evaluation.
key_innovation.zh: 本文構建一個模組化的 agent 設計空間,包含四種具統一 IO 介面的標準化模組(Planning、Reasoning、Tool-Use、Memory),並透過兩個由 LLM 驅動的運算子進行離線搜尋:模組重組(由一個 LLM proposer 替換既有模組)與模組演化(由一個 LLM 演化式 meta-prompt 撰寫全新的模組程式碼)。此外,本文以一個 in-context 的 LLM 代理模型「performance predictor」加速搜尋,對重組後的候選架構進行評分與排序,以在耗費成本的真實評測之前剪除(跳過)不具潛力的設計。

baselines_compared: CoT, CoT-SC, Self-refine, ToT, Step Back, Thought Propagation, HuggingGPT, Voyager, Generative Agents, DEPS

key_improvements.en: +17.2% avg over best human designs on 6 agentic benchmarks; surrogate predictor evaluates at ~0.025% of full cost.
key_improvements.zh: 六個 agentic 評測平均較最佳人工設計 +17.2%;代理預測器評估成本僅約完整評估的 0.025%。

decision_mechanism: Evolutionary / swarm search, Heuristic scoring / ranking
benchmarks_used: AlfWorld, ScienceWorld, PDDL, WebShop, TravelPlanner, M3ToolEval

agent_scenario.en: The "agents" being searched are single modular LLM agents whose internal architecture is composed of four functional module types (Planning, Reasoning, Tool-Use, Memory) rather than a team of collaborating agents — this is agent-architecture search over one agent's internal module composition, not a multi-agent topology. The searched agent solves single tasks in embodied (ALFWorld, ScienceWorld), game (PDDL), web (WebShop), and tool-use (TravelPlanner, M3ToolEval) benchmarks, drawing tools from a tool pool via its Tool-Use module. The search process itself is LLM-driven: an LLM proposer (π_θ) performs module recombination, an LLM evolver (π_ξ) writes new module code, and an LLM surrogate (π_p) predicts performance to prune candidates, all instantiated with GPT-3.5-turbo-0125 or GPT-4o. Search is offline and per-domain.
agent_scenario.zh: 被搜尋的「agent」為單一的模組化 LLM agent,其內部架構由四種功能模組類型(Planning、Reasoning、Tool-Use、Memory)組成,而非由多個協作 agent 構成的團隊;此處為針對單一 agent 內部模組組成的 agent 架構搜尋,並非 multi-agent 拓撲。所搜尋出的 agent 在具身(ALFWorld、ScienceWorld)、遊戲(PDDL)、網頁(WebShop)與工具使用(TravelPlanner、M3ToolEval)等 benchmark 上求解單一任務,並透過其 Tool-Use 模組自工具池中取用工具。搜尋過程本身由 LLM 驅動:一個 LLM proposer(π_θ)執行模組重組,一個 LLM evolver(π_ξ)撰寫新的模組程式碼,一個 LLM 代理模型(π_p)預測效能以剪除候選架構,三者皆以 GPT-3.5-turbo-0125 或 GPT-4o 實例化。搜尋為離線且按領域分別進行。
